observations: Two photos show a large rectangular office table with a light brown wooden top and a black metal frame with four legs.
The table has a central circular hole in the top surface, likely for cable management.
The table is outdoors on a wet, paved ground, surrounded by other furniture and people.
The table appears to be in used condition with some visible wear and dirt, especially on the legs and base.
No brand or model is visible on the table in either photo.
The seller claims it is 'good quality used but very clean' and 'bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm'.

claims.claim: Office table with good quality used but very clean
claims.evidence: The table shows visible wear and dirt, especially on the legs and base, contradicting 'very clean'. The 'good quality' claim is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Structural damage or instability due to wear and dirt on legs and base
risks.proof: Close-up shot of the table legs and base, especially under the table, to check for cracks, warping, or loose joints.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or damaged

risks.risk: Surface damage or scratches not visible in current lighting
risks.proof: Close-up shot of the wooden top surface, especially edges and corners, under direct light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly having hidden surface damage

risks.risk: Table may not be functional (e.g., legs wobbly, drawer not working)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the table being moved or a close-up of the drawer mechanism if present.

proof_requests: Close-up of the table legs and base to check for structural damage.
Close-up of the wooden top surface under direct light to check for scratches or damage.
Video or photo showing the table being moved or a close-up of the drawer mechanism if present.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
